note: Any pedestrian on a dim or dark power night (ENGINE N2).

lines.text: Whole block's dark! Is it the whole city?
Hudson Union says an hour. Hudson Union always says an hour.
Watch it! Signal's out! Nobody's got the light!
Somebody's got a radio! Come on, sit on the stoop!
Hold your bag tight. Dark streets have long arms.
My mother's on the twelfth floor. Elevator's out.
No lights, no TV, no fans. Just us and the heat.
Candles for sale! Candles! Quarter apiece!
Ice cream truck's giving it away before it melts!
Fur vaults on Thirtieth need power. Somebody's sweating more than us.
City can't pay for lights. Now we see what we're worth.
Stay together, everybody. Stay where it's lit.
